objectives.title: Go to the workshop
objectives.description: The Ark is dark, and the emergency power is failing. Find your way to the workshop.
objectives.hint: Follow the yellow service lights down the corridor. The workshop is aft.

objectives.title: Restore emergency power
objectives.description: The emergency power coupling in the workshop has come loose. Reconnect it.
objectives.hint: Find the coupling on the workshop's back wall and press E.

objectives.title: Visit the embryo bank
objectives.description: 50,000 embryos sleep in the cold. See them with your own eyes.
objectives.hint: The embryo bank is amidships. Go to the board with the number.

objectives.title: Open the star map
objectives.description: See where the Ark can go.
objectives.hint: Go up to the bridge and use the star map at the command console.

objectives.title: Compare the candidates
objectives.description: Send a remote probe, or compare the known worlds.
objectives.hint: Open the Comparison tab on the star map, or send a probe: it costs components but resolves an important uncertainty.

objectives.title: Travel to a candidate
objectives.description: Choose a world and set a course.
objectives.hint: Choose a planet on the star map. The route shows fuel and wear.

objectives.title: Scan the planet from orbit
objectives.description: Find climate, gravity and possible landing sites.
objectives.hint: Use the orbital terminal on the bridge. The scan takes one day.

objectives.title: Complete an expedition
objectives.description: Take surface samples and place a relay.
objectives.hint: Choose a landing site and take the lander down. Watch the suit's energy.

objectives.title: Confirm the landing
objectives.description: The Ark lands for the last time. It cannot be undone.
objectives.hint: Review the colony plan on the bridge and confirm when you are sure.

objectives.title: Build a power supply
objectives.description: Build a solar array or a geothermal generator.
objectives.hint: Pick a power source in the build bar at the bottom and click the ground to place it. Choose one that suits the planet.

objectives.title: Build a water plant
objectives.description: The colony needs clean water.
objectives.hint: Place the water plant close to water and within range of the supply network.

objectives.title: Build a habitat
objectives.description: People need a place to live.
objectives.hint: Build the habitat in the living zone. Check whether the planet requires a module.

objectives.title: Stabilize supply
objectives.description: Keep a power and water surplus for seven days in a row.
objectives.hint: The supply balance is shown at the top. A battery helps through night and bad weather.

objectives.title: Build the care center
objectives.description: New life needs a place to be cared for.
objectives.hint: The care center must stand in the living zone with stable power.

objectives.title: Start the first cohort
objectives.description: Begin incubating ten embryos.
objectives.hint: Open the care center. The requirements are shown before you can start.

objectives.title: Wait for the first birth
objectives.description: Keep the colony stable while the first cohort grows.
objectives.hint: Incubation takes 270 days. Keep the reserves up.

objectives.title: Build the school
objectives.description: The children must learn more than the robots can teach them.
objectives.hint: Build the school and town hall in the living zone once the first cohort is born.

objectives.title: Form a council
objectives.description: Let the colony begin to govern itself.
objectives.hint: The council meets in the school and town hall once the first cohort has grown up.

objectives.title: Reach year 20
objectives.description: Guide the colony safely through its first twenty years.
objectives.hint: Use the time leap. It stops at unresolved crises.

objectives.title: Year 40: 500 people
objectives.description: A self-sufficient community of at least 500 inhabitants and a council.
objectives.hint: Build up reserves, start more cohorts and reduce dependence on the Ark.
